summary: Revised Phase A to establish a concrete, screen-by-screen enterprise implementation blueprint. Replaced generic SaaS visuals with a crisp, structured operational system that respects explicit terminology, synthetic boundaries, and performance constraints.

/.name: Landing & Product Story
/.user_purpose: Communicate the core value: 'Keep tomorrow’s cancer treatment on track.'
/.main_content: Hero statement, visual signature sequence (patient concern -> clinical/logistical paths -> accountable owners -> confirmed plan), and consolidated solution/interoperability sections.
/.working_interactions: Scroll-based signature sequence (CSS only), navigation to Trust and Sign-in.
/.loading_empty_error: Instant load static content. Disabled states not applicable.
/.responsive: Single column on mobile, robust multi-column grid on presentation laptops.

/trust.name: Trust Center
/trust.user_purpose: Explain data minimization, workflow traceability, and simulated boundaries.
/trust.main_content: Structured text sections detailing human clinical authority and sandbox architecture.
/trust.static_read_only: All content. No fake certification badges.

/sign-in.name: Sandbox Entry
/sign-in.user_purpose: Provide local perspective selection into the product demo.
/sign-in.working_interactions: Clicking a persona immediately routes to their respective portal, establishing local session state.
/sign-in.static_read_only: Explanatory text that this is a simulated local sandbox.
/sign-in.loading_empty_error: Error: 'Please select a sandbox role to continue.'

persistent_shell.layout: Fixed 240px left sidebar for routing. Top bar for current context and 'Reset Demo' utility. No hidden avatar menus for primary routing.

/staff.name: Command Center
/staff.user_purpose: Operational morning view prioritizing treatments approaching in 24-48 hours.
/staff.main_content: Top rails of upcoming treatments, exception workload summary, and a prominent link to Maria's active case.
/staff.key_synthetic_data: Aggregated ownership and upcoming treatment counts (static context). Maria's headline state (dynamic).
/staff.working_interactions: Routing to Exceptions or Case Workspace.
/staff.loading_empty_error: No-result state: 'No immediate treatments at risk.'
/staff.responsive: Grid scales to stack on tablets; designed primarily for landscape presentation.

/staff/exceptions.name: Exceptions
/staff/exceptions.main_content: Structured table/list showing urgency, blocker type, owner, and state.
/staff/exceptions.key_synthetic_data: Secondary static exception rows for context.
/staff/exceptions.working_interactions: Search input, column filters, clear filters, routing.
/staff/exceptions.responsive: Horizontal scrolling for table on narrow viewports.

/staff/case/maria.name: Maria Case Workspace
/staff/case/maria.main_content: Treatment Readiness Graph, dual-action workspace (clinical and transportation), caregiver permission context, and Causal Audit Timeline.
/staff/case/maria.key_synthetic_data: Maria's generated IDs, timestamps, and role assignments.
/staff/case/maria.working_interactions: Acknowledging the clinical task, confirming transportation, deriving timeline updates. Guards prevent out-of-order actions.
/staff/case/maria.loading_empty_error: Disabled CTAs until preconditions met. Success state highlights graph path in emerald.
/staff/case/maria.responsive: Two-column desktop layout stacks to single column on narrow screens.

/staff/resources.name: Resources
/staff/resources.static_read_only: The entire catalog (action is taken within Maria's case).
/staff/resources.responsive: Grid cards adapt to viewport width.

/staff/insights.name: Insights
/staff/insights.main_content: Charts for exception aging and resolution.
/staff/insights.key_synthetic_data: Static historical trends; dynamic Maria summary.

/staff/integrations.name: Integrations
/staff/integrations.main_content: FHIR sandbox resource mappings and proposed event history.

/staff/admin.name: Admin
/staff/admin.user_purpose: View local routing and role configuration.
/staff/admin.static_read_only: All fields rendered read-only or disabled with 'Local demo' tooltip.

/patient.name: Patient Experience
/patient.main_content: Treatment countdown, readiness check form, and status view.
/patient.working_interactions: Form submission (creates two tasks in shared state), final plan acknowledgment.
/patient.loading_empty_error: Validation error if form incomplete. Success state upon confirmation.

/caregiver.name: Caregiver Experience
/caregiver.working_interactions: Live state reflection from staff actions.
/caregiver.loading_empty_error: Explicit boundary text ensuring clinical data is absent.

terminology_and_boundaries.clinical_authority: Replaced 'Clearance' with 'Review requested', 'Review acknowledged', and 'Disposition recorded'.
terminology_and_boundaries.privacy: Caregiver view uses an explicit allowlist. No clinical text in DOM or ARIA.

motion_plan.signature_sequences: CSS-driven causal path on landing; 300ms layout transition for readiness split; 400ms color transition for graph resolution.
motion_plan.performance: 0ms structural navigation. No per-second tick re-renders for countdowns. Full prefers-reduced-motion fallback to 0ms instant state changes.
